surface: Photographed dark cherry/mahogany veneer; stained toward darker walnut for the game. Not a claim of scanned walnut species.
runtimeTransform: Diffuse multiplied in sRGB by [0.76,0.95,1.12]; normal unchanged; roughness remapped to 0.29 + 0.34 * source. All three share one UV tile.
runtimeTexture: public/assets/material-table-walnut-albedo.jpg (quality 94, no chroma subsampling), matching PNG normal and roughness
sceneMapping: All three maps share Detail UV and repeat 0.8/6; one tile is 6 stylized scene units, chosen in real WebGL at 1K/75%.
